blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sequential prediction problems such as imitation learning, where future observations depend on previous predictions (actions), violate the common i.i.d. assumptions made in statistical learning. This leads to poor performance in theory and often in practice. Some recent approaches (Daumé III et al., 2009; Ross and Bagnell, 2010) provide stronger guarantees in this setting, but remain somewhat unsatisfactory as they train either non-stationary or stochastic policies and require a large number of iterations. In this paper, we propose a new iterative algorithm, which trains a stationary deterministic policy, that can be seen as a no regret algorithm in an online learning setting. We show that any such no regret algorithm, combined with additional reduction assumptions, must find a policy with good performance under the distribution of observations it induces in such sequential settings. We demonstrate that this new approach outperforms previous approaches on two challenging imitation learning problems and a benchmark sequence labeling problem.
blocks.zh: 诸如模仿学习等序列预测问题中，未来的观测依赖于先前的预测（动作），这违背了统计学习中常见的独立同分布（i.i.d.）假设。这导致其在理论上以及往往在实践中表现不佳。近期的一些方法（Daumé III et al., 2009; Ross and Bagnell, 2010）在该设定下提供了更强的保证，但仍不尽如人意，因为它们训练的是非平稳或随机策略，并且需要大量的迭代次数。在本文中，我们提出了一种训练平稳确定性策略的新迭代算法，该算法可被视为在线学习设定下的无遗憾算法。我们证明，任何此类无遗憾算法在结合额外的归约假设后，都必然能在此类序列设定中、在其诱导的观测分布下找到具有良好性能的策略。我们证明了这一新方法在两个具有挑战性的模仿学习问题和一个基准序列标注问题上均优于以往的方法。

In particular, a classifier that makes a mistake with probability ϵ under the distribution of states/observations encountered by the expert can make as many as T2 ϵ mistakes in expectation over T -steps under the distribution of states the classifier itself induces (Ross and Bagnell, 2010). blocks.en: Recent approaches (Ross and Bagnell, 2010) can guarantee an expected number of mistakes linear (or nearly so) in the task horizon T and error ϵ by training over several iterations and allowing the learner to influence the input states where expert demonstration is provided (through execution of its own controls in the system). One approach (Ross and Bagnell, 2010) learns a non-stationary policy by training a different policy for each time step in sequence, starting from the first step. Unfortunately this is impractical when T is large or ill-defined. Another approach called SMILe (Ross and Bagnell, 2010), similar to SEARN (Daumé III et al., 2009) and CPI (Kakade and Langford, 2002), trains a stationary stochastic policy (a finite mixture of policies) by adding a new policy to the mixture at each iteration of training. blocks.en: We propose a new meta-algorithm for imitation learning which learns a stationary deterministic policy guaranteed to perform well under its induced distribution of states (number of mistakes/costs that grows linearly in T and classification cost ϵ ). We take a reduction-based approach (Beygelzimer et al., 2005) that enables reusing existing supervised learning algorithms. Our approach is simple to implement, has no free parameters except the supervised learning algorithm sub-routine, and requires a number of iterations that scales nearly linearly with the effective horizon of the problem. It naturally handles continuous as well as discrete predictions. Our approach is closely related to no regret online learning algorithms (Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2004; Hazan et al., 2006; Kakade and Shalev-Shwartz, 2008) (in particular Follow-The-Leader ) but better leverages the expert in our setting. Additionally, we show that any no-regret learner can be used in a particular fashion to learn a policy that achieves similar guarantees.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一种新的模仿学习元算法，该算法学习一个平稳确定性策略，保证在其诱导的状态分布下表现良好（错误数/代价关于 T 和分类代价 ϵ 呈线性增长）。我们采用基于归约的方法（Beygelzimer et al., 2005），能够复用现有的监督学习算法。我们的方法易于实现，除监督学习算法子程序外没有自由参数，并且所需的迭代次数与问题的有效时界呈近线性缩放。它能够自然地处理连续预测和离散预测。我们的方法与无遗憾在线学习算法（Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2004; Hazan et al., 2006; Kakade and Shalev-Shwartz, 2008）（特别是 Follow-The-Leader）密切相关，但在我们的设定下能更好地利用专家。此外，我们证明了任何无遗憾学习器都可以通过特定方式用于学习能够达到类似保证的策略。

blocks.en: We begin by establishing our notation and setting, discuss related work, and then present the DAGGER (Dataset Aggregation) method. We analyze this approach using a noregret and a reduction approach (Beygelzimer et al., 2005). Beyond the reduction analysis, we consider the sample complexity of our approach using online-to-batch (CesaBianchi et al., 2004) techniques. We demonstrate DAGGER is scalable and outperforms previous approaches in practice on two challenging imitation learning problems: 1) learning to steer a car in a 3D racing game ( Super Tux Kart ) and 2) and learning to play Super Mario Bros. , given input image features and corresponding actions by a human expert and near-optimal planner respectively. Following Daumé III et al. (2009) in treating structured prediction as a degenerate imitation learning problem, we apply DAGGER to the OCR (Taskar et al., 2003) benchmark prediction problem achieving results competitive with the state-of-the-art (Taskar et al., 2003; Ratliff et al., 2007; Daumé III et al., 2009) using only single-pass, greedy prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们首先确立符号和设定，讨论相关工作，随后提出 DAGGER（Dataset Aggregation）方法。我们利用无遗憾和归约方法（Beygelzimer et al., 2005）对该方法进行了分析。除归约分析外，我们还利用在线到批量（CesaBianchi et al., 2004）技术考察了我们方法的样本复杂度。我们证明了 DAGGER 具有可扩展性，并在两个具有挑战性的模仿学习问题上在实践中优于以往方法：1）在 3D 赛车游戏（Super Tux Kart）中学习赛车转向；2）分别基于人类专家和近最优规划器给出的输入图像特征及对应动作，学习玩 Super Mario Bros.。借鉴 Daumé III et al. (2009) 将结构化预测视为退化模仿学习问题的做法，我们将 DAGGER 应用于 OCR（Taskar et al., 2003）基准预测问题，仅使用单遍贪心预测就取得了与最前沿方法（Taskar et al., 2003; Ratliff et al., 2007; Daumé III et al., 2009）相媲美的结果。

blocks.zh: 2 预备知识

Furthermore, we denote dπ = T1 � Tt =1d πtthe average distribution of states if we follow policy π for T steps. Given a state s , we denote C ( s, a ) the expected immediate cost of performing action a in state s for the task we are considering and denote Cπ ( s ) = E a∼π ( s )[ C ( s, a )] the expected immediate cost of π in s . We assume C is bounded in [0 , 1]. The total cost of executing policy π for T -steps ( i.e. , the cost-to-go) is denoted J ( π ) =�T t =1Es∼dt π[Cπ(s)] =TEs∼d π[Cπ(s)].
blocks.zh: 我们首先介绍与我们设定相关的符号。我们用 Π 表示学习者所考虑的策略类，用 T 表示任务时界。对于任意策略 π，我们用 dt π 表示如果学习者从时间步 1 到 t − 1 执行策略 π 时在时间 t 的状态分布。此外，我们用〔行内公式见原版〕表示如果遵循策略 π 执行 T 步时的平均状态分布。给定状态 s，我们用 C ( s, a ) 表示在我们所考虑的任务中在状态 s 下执行动作 a 的期望即时代价，并用 Cπ ( s ) = E a∼π ( s )[ C ( s, a )] 表示 π 在 s 下的期望即时代价。我们假设 C 有界于 [0 , 1]。执行策略 π 经历 T-steps 的总代价（即 cost-to-go）记为〔行内公式见原版〕。

blocks.en: In imitation learning, we may not necessarily know or observe true costs C ( s, a ) for the particular task. Instead, we observe expert demonstrations and seek to bound J ( π ) for any cost function C based on how well π mimics the expert’s policy π∗ . Denote ℓ the observed surrogate loss function we minimize instead of C . For instance ℓ ( s, π ) may be the expected 0-1 loss of π with respect to π∗ in state s , or a squared/hinge loss of π with respect to π∗ in s . Importantly, in many instances, C and ℓ may be the same function– for instance, if we are interested in optimizing the learner’s ability to predict the actions chosen by an expert.
blocks.zh: 在模仿学习中，对于特定任务，我们不一定知晓或能够观测到真实代价 C ( s, a )。相反，我们观测专家示教，并力求基于 π 模仿专家策略 π∗ 的优劣程度，对任意代价函数 C 的 J ( π ) 给出界。记 ℓ 为我们用以替代 C 进行最小化的观测代理损失函数。例如，ℓ ( s, π ) 可以是状态 s 下 π 相对于 π∗ 的期望 0-1 损失，或者是状态 s 下 π 相对于 π∗ 的平方/合页损失。重要的是，在许多情况下，C 与 ℓ 可以是同一个函数——例如，如果我们关注的是优化学习者预测专家所选动作的能力。

blocks.en: Our goal is to find a policy ˆ π which minimizes the observed surrogate loss under its induced distribution of states, i.e.:
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是找到一个策略 ˆ π，以最小化在其诱导的状态分布下的观测代理损失，即：

blocks.en: π ˆ = arg min E s∼dπ [ ℓ ( s, π )] (1) π∈ Π

As system dynamics are assumed both unknown and complex, we cannot compute dπ and can only sample it by executing π in the system. Hence this is a non-i.i.d. supervised learning problem due to the dependence of the input distribution on the policy π itself. The interaction between policy and the resulting distribution makes optimization difficult as it results in a non-convex objective even if the loss ℓ ( s, · ) is convex in π for all states s . We now briefly review previous approaches and their guarantees.
blocks.zh: 由于系统动力学被假定为既未知又复杂，我们无法直接计算 dπ，只能通过在系统中执行 π 对其进行采样。因此，由于输入分布对策略 π 自身存在依赖性，这是一个非 i.i.d. 的监督学习问题。策略与所产生分布之间的相互作用使得优化变得困难，因为即使损失 ℓ ( s, · ) 对所有状态 s 关于 π 都是凸的，它也会导致非凸的目标函数。下面我们简要回顾以往的方法及其理论保证。

blocks.en: 2.2 Forward Training
blocks.zh: 2.2 前向训练

blocks.en: The forward training algorithm introduced by Ross and Bagnell (2010) trains a non-stationary policy (one policy πt for each time step t ) iteratively over T iterations, where at iteration t , πt is trained to mimic π∗ on the distribution of states at time t induced by the previously trained policies π 1 , π 2 , . . . , πt− 1. By doing so, πt is trained on the actual distribution of states it will encounter during execution of the learned policy. Hence the forward algorithm guarantees that the expected loss under the distribution of states induced by the learned policy matches the average loss during training, and hence improves performance.
blocks.zh: Ross and Bagnell (2010) 提出的前向训练算法在 T 次迭代中迭代训练一个非平稳策略（每个时间步 t 对应一个策略 πt）。在迭代 t 中，πt 被训练为在先前训练的策略 π 1 , π 2 , . . . , πt− 1 所诱导的时间 t 的状态分布上模仿 π∗。通过这种方式，πt 是在其执行所学策略期间实际会遇到的状态分布上进行训练的。因此，前向算法保证了在所学策略诱导的状态分布下的期望损失与训练期间的平均损失相匹配，从而提升了性能。

blocks.en: SMILe, proposed by Ross and Bagnell (2010), alleviates this problem and can be applied in practice when T is large or undefined by adopting an approach similar to SEARN (Daumé III et al., 2009) where a stochastic stationary policy is trained over several iterations. Initially SMILe starts with a policy π 0 which always queries and executes the expert’s action choice. At iteration n , a policy π ˆ n is trained to mimic the expert under the distribution of trajectories πn− 1 induces and then updates πn = πn− 1 + α (1 − α )n−1 (ˆ πn − π 0). This update is interpreted as adding probability α (1 − α )n−1 to executing policy π ˆ n at any step and removing probability α (1 − α )n−1 of executing the queried expert’s action. At iteration n , πn is a mixture of n policies and the probability of using the queried expert’s action is (1 − α )n . We can stop the algorithm at any iteration N by returning the re-normalized policy ˜ πN =πN−(1−α)Nπ0 which doesn’t query the expert 1 − (1 −α )N anymore. Ross and Bagnell (2010) showed that choosing α in O ( T12)andNinO(T2 logT)guaranteesnear-linear regret in T and ϵ for some class of problems.
blocks.zh: Ross and Bagnell (2010) 提出的 SMILe 缓解了这一问题；通过采用类似于 SEARN（Daumé III et al., 2009）的方法，在多个迭代中训练一个随机平稳策略，SMILe 能够在 T 很大或未定义时应用于实践。最初，SMILe 从一个始终查询并执行专家所选动作的策略 π 0 开始。在迭代 n，训练一个策略 π ˆ n，用于在 πn− 1 所诱导的轨迹分布下模仿专家，随后更新 πn = πn− 1 + α (1 − α )n−1 (ˆ πn − π 0)。这一更新被解释为：在任意步骤执行策略 π ˆ n 的概率增加 α (1 − α )n−1，而执行被查询专家的动作的概率减少 α (1 − α )n−1。在迭代 n，πn 是 n 个策略的混合，使用被查询专家动作的概率为 (1 − α )n。我们可以在任意迭代 N 停止算法，返回不再查询专家的重新归一化策略〔行内公式见原版〕。Ross and Bagnell (2010) 证明，选择 α 属于〔行内公式见原版〕且 N 属于〔行内公式见原版〕能够保证对于某些类别的问题在 T 和 ϵ 上实现近线性遗憾。

blocks.en: 3 DATASET AGGREGATION
blocks.zh: 3 数据集聚合

blocks.en: We now present DAGGER (Dataset Aggregation), an iterative algorithm that trains a deterministic policy that achieves good performance guarantees under its induced distribution of states.
blocks.zh: 我们现在提出 DAGGER（数据集聚合，Dataset Aggregation），这是一种迭代算法，用于训练一个确定性策略，该策略在其所诱导的状态分布下能获得良好的性能保证。

blocks.en: In its simplest form, the algorithm proceeds as follows. At the first iteration, it uses the expert’s policy to gather a dataset of trajectories D and train a policy π ˆ2 that best mimics the expert on those trajectories. Then at iteration n , it uses π ˆ n to collect more trajectories and adds those trajectories to the dataset D . The next policy π ˆ n +1 is the policy that best mimics the expert on the whole dataset D .
blocks.zh: 该算法的最简单形式如下。在第 1 次迭代中，它利用专家策略收集一个轨迹数据集 D，并训练一个在这些轨迹上最好地模仿专家的策略 π ˆ2。然后在第 n 次迭代中，它利用 π ˆ n 收集更多轨迹并将这些轨迹添加到数据集 D 中。下一个策略 π ˆ n +1 则是能够在整个数据集 D 上最好地模仿专家的策略。

blocks.en: In other words, DAGGER proceeds by collecting a dataset at each iteration under the current policy and trains the next policy under the aggregate of all collected datasets. The intuition behind this algorithm is that over the iterations, we are building up the set of inputs that the learned policy is likely to encounter during its execution based on previous experience (training iterations). This algorithm can be interpreted as a Follow-The-Leader algorithm in that at iteration n we pick the best policy ˆ πn +1 in hindsight, i.e. under all trajectories seen so far over the iterations.
blocks.zh: 换句话说，DAGGER 的运行方式是在每次迭代中收集当前策略下的数据集，并在所有已收集数据集的聚合集上训练下一个策略。该算法背后的直觉在于，随着迭代的进行，我们正基于以往的经验（训练迭代）构建出所学策略在执行过程中可能遇到的一组输入。该算法可以被解释为一种“跟随领导者”（Follow-The-Leader）算法，因为在第 n 次迭代中，我们事后选择最佳策略 ˆ πn +1，即在迄今为止所有迭代中所见的所有轨迹下表现最优的策略。

blocks.en: To better leverage the presence of the expert in our imitation learning setting, we optionally allow the algorithm to use a modified policy πi = βiπ∗ + (1 − βi )ˆ πi at iteration i that queries the expert to choose controls a fraction of the time while collecting the next dataset. This is often desirable in practice as the first few policies, with relatively few datapoints, may make many more mistakes and visit states that are irrelevant as the policy improves.
blocks.zh: 为了在我们的动作模仿设定中更好地利用专家的存在，我们允许算法在迭代 i 中选择性地使用修改后的策略 πi = βiπ∗ + (1 − βi )ˆ πi；该策略在收集下一个数据集时，有一部分时间会查询专家以选择控制量。这在实践中通常是可取的，因为最初的几个策略由于数据点相对较少，可能会犯多得多的错误，并访问那些随着策略改进而变得无关紧要的状态。

blocks.en: 4 THEORETICAL ANALYSIS
blocks.zh: 4 理论分析

blocks.en: The theoretical analysis of DAGGER only relies on the noregret property of the underlying Follow-The-Leader algorithm on strongly convex losses (Kakade and Tewari, 2009) which picks the sequence of policies π ˆ1: N . Hence the presented results also hold for any other no regret online learning algorithm we would apply to our imitation learning setting. In particular, we can consider the results here a reduction of imitation learning to no-regret online learning where we treat mini-batches of trajectories under a single policy as a single online-learning example. We first briefly review concepts of online learning and no regret that will be used for this analysis.
blocks.zh: DAGGER 的理论分析仅依赖于底层“跟随领导者”（Follow-The-Leader）算法在强凸损失上的无悔（no-regret）性质（Kakade and Tewari, 2009），该算法选取了策略序列 π ˆ1: N。因此，所给出的结果对于我们应用到动作模仿设定中的任何其他无悔在线学习算法同样成立。特别是，我们可以将本文的结果视为将动作模仿归约为无悔在线学习，其中我们将单一策略下的轨迹小批量（mini-batch）视为单个在线学习样本。我们首先简要回顾将用于本分析的在线学习与无悔概念。

blocks.en: 5.3 Handwriting Recognition
blocks.zh: 5.3 手写识别

blocks.en: Finally, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach on a structured prediction problem involving recognizing handwritten words given the sequence of images of each character in the word. We follow Daumé III et al. (2009) in adopting a view of structured prediction as a degenerate form of imitation learning where the system dynamics are deterministic and trivial in simply passing on earlier predictions made as inputs for future predictions. We use the dataset of Taskar et al. (2003) which has been used extensively in the literature to compare several structured prediction approaches. This dataset contains roughly 6600 words (for a total of over 52000 characters) partitioned in 10 folds. We consider the large dataset experiment which consists of training on 9 folds and testing on 1 fold and repeating this over all folds. Performance is measured in terms of the character accuracy on the test folds.

blocks.en: 6 FUTURE WORK
blocks.zh: 6 未来工作

blocks.en: We show that by batching over iterations of interaction with a system, no-regret methods, including the presented DAGGER approach can provide a learning reduction with strong performance guarantees in both imitation learning and structured prediction. In future work, we will consider more sophisticated strategies than simple greedy forward decoding for structured prediction, as well as using base classifiers that rely on Inverse Optimal Control (Abbeel and Ng, 2004; Ratliff et al., 2006) techniques to learn a cost function for a planner to aid prediction in imitation learning. Further we believe techniques similar to those presented, by leveraging a cost-to-go estimate, may provide an understanding of the success of online methods for reinforcement learning and suggest a similar data-aggregation method that can guarantee performance in such settings.
blocks.zh: 我们证明，通过对与系统交互的各次迭代进行批处理，包括本文提出的 DAGGER 方法在内的无悔（no-regret）方法能够在模仿学习和结构化预测中提供具有强大性能保证的学习归约。在未来的工作中，我们将考虑在结构化预测中采用比简单贪心前向解码更复杂的策略，并使用基于逆最优控制（Inverse Optimal Control, Abbeel and Ng, 2004; Ratliff et al., 2006）技术的基分类器来为规划器学习代价函数，以辅助模仿学习中的预测。此外，我们认为类似于本文提出的技术，通过利用 cost-to-go 估计，可能有助于理解在线强化学习方法的成功机理，并启发类似的数据聚合（data-aggregation）方法以在此类场景下提供性能保证。
